newsitem.title: UK: King to join State Street after KBIM shake-up.
newsitem.headline: King to join State Street after KBIM shake-up.

text.p: Former Kleinwort Benson Investment Management emerging markets head Ken King will join State Street Global Advisors (SSGA) to head up a London asset management arm specialising in emerging markets.
SSGA said the company, King Street Advisors Ltd, was expected to begin operations in midyear, subject to regulatory approval.
King will be managing director of the firm, and he will be joined by 10 to 12 other emerging markets specialists from Kleinwort and other organisations.

It will be part of SSGA Global Alliance, formed earlier in the year to develop new business offering non-traditional investments for institutions and individuals. SSGA will have majority ownership of the firm and provide it with marketing and operational support.
Boston-based SSGA has $8.5 billion invested in emerging markets out of more than $320 billion under management worldwide.
King left KBIM following a restructuring of the firm's emerging market operations. He is one of eight staff to leave KBIM, owned by Germany's Dresdner Bank AG, as a result of the shake-up.

Dresdner RCM Global Investors, incorporating KBIM, has restructured its global equity emerging markets team, appointing global equity chief William Stack to lead a six person asset allocation committee and three regional teams consisting of 20 country and regional specialists.
Dresdner RCM has over $50 billion under management.
